question: Checkout latency paged at 15:31:19Z on 2026-10-25. Investigate 15:20Z to 15:42Z on that date. What is the cause?
provenance: Codex fresh-context sub-agent; inherited GPT-6 session model, exact API model identifier not exposed

hypotheses.claim: Checkout latency was propagated from slow product-catalog calls to astronomy-db.
hypotheses.uncertainty: Histogram p95 values at the highest finite bucket are capped estimates; about 26.2% of astronomy-db calls exceeded 15000 ms at 15:31Z. Metrics localize the slow dependency but cannot establish whether its mechanism was a database lock, slow SQL, I/O, or network delay.

hypotheses.claim: Product-catalog connection-pool capacity exhaustion caused database waits.
hypotheses.uncertainty: More in-use connections alone does not demonstrate pool contention; the observed wait counters provide no evidence of waiting for pool capacity.

hypotheses.claim: Payment CPU saturation caused checkout latency.
hypotheses.uncertainty: The CPU ratio has no abrupt incident boundary and continues increasing after checkout recovery; without CPU limits its magnitude alone cannot establish saturation. Payment call latency remains small.
